scores.notes: Both show a ridged, tussocky lawn enclosed by a low pinkish brick wall with trees behind and scattered small figures; left adds a topiary arch and right a foreground tree, compatible as different viewpoints.

Left is an open lawn bounded by a red brick wall with broad orchard trees; right is bounded by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical cypresses, so the enclosing wall and planting conflict.
Both show a wet sandy seabed corridor between towering dark-green wave walls under storm cloud, leading back to a sandy shore with red sandstone cliffs.
Both show a rough-mown lawn backed by a low pink brick wall with large trees beyond; the right adds a clipped hedge and cypresses, which is compatible with another view of the same walled garden.

Both show a calm lake cove under tawny cliff-topped hills with a whitewashed flat-roofed village and cypresses on the far slope, and a fire on a low stony shore; the right's shore is grassier with olive trees but seen from the water at a distance.
Jesus (standing in the boat left, crouching at the fire right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim face and age, plus the same white tunic and blue-grey mantle.

Both show a table on a lawn under a massive oak in front of a half-timbered red-brick house with a tiled roof; the table is bare wood on the left and cloth-covered on the right and the house is closer on the right, but the house, tree and lawn agree.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, rope coils and a stern cushion on open water under heavy storm cloud; the right is darker with high waves and no shore visible, which is the storm-to-calm change the passages call for.

Both show the same single-masted wooden boat on a grey-green lake under storm cloud with tawny hills and a small village with cypresses on the shore; only the sea state and sail differ, as the passages require.
Peter (wading ashore in the centre left, leaping from the boat right) is in both a sturdy older man with curly greying hair, a short grey beard and a weathered tanned face; only the cloak differs.

Left is the courtyard of pale limestone flat-roofed houses and right the stony road outside a village of the same pale stone houses; both look out over the same rolling olive-dotted hills to a distant lake under broken cloud.
Both show the same single-masted wooden boat with a furled/loose canvas sail on a dark heaving sea with dark headlands on the right horizon under storm cloud; the left adds only a break of light.

Both show a grey overcast lake with dark cliff-topped hills and a fire on a low stony shore at the water's edge; the right adds a village with palms on the far slope, which the left's viewpoint from the water does not contradict.

Both show a circular pit of grey dressed stone blocks with a sandy floor and lions in daylight, seen from inside on the left and from the rim on the right; the left's wall closes into a hooded opening with a grate that the right's open rim lacks, but the stonework, shape and floor agree.

Moses (front centre with crook staff left; on the rock with raised arms right) is in both an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, lean build and the same crook-topped staff; on the right he is seen from behind in part-profile, hair a little longer in the wind, but no cue conflicts.
Both show a lawn mown into ridges and furrows, enclosed by a red brick wall with shrub borders and tall trees behind; the layout is compatible from two viewpoints.

Table under a big oak on grass in both, but the house behind conflicts: left is a plain tan clapboard cottage with square windows and a simple porch, right is a grey-lavender ornate Victorian house with a tall central gable, arched windows and fretwork porch.

Left is enclosed by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical cypresses under a dark sky; right is an open sunlit lawn with a red brick wall, flower border and spreading trees, so the wall and planting conflict.

Left is a dark night storm at a grey rocky shore with palms and an unparted sea; right is a pale daylit sandy corridor between water walls leading to red mesa cliffs, so both the lighting (night vs day) and the shoreline conflict.
Both show a plank table on grass under a large spreading oak with a pale clapboard house and porch close behind and leafy bushes around; the cloth on the right table is the only difference.

Both show an open single-masted wooden boat with oars and rope coils on a grey-green lake under dark storm cloud with low hills on the horizon; the left boat has a scroll-carved sternpost the right lacks, a minor detail against the matching lake, hills and boat type.

Both show the same open single-masted wooden boat with oars and rope coils on a dark blue choppy lake with green-grey hills across the water under storm cloud; the right only adds clearing light, as the passage requires.
Jesus (standing by the mast left, seated at the fire right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, lean face and age, with the same white tunic and blue mantle.

Clothed table under a big tree on grass in both, but the house conflicts: left is a rough stone-and-plaster cottage with a steep shingle roof, dormers, bay window and small gabled porch; right is a weathered white clapboard house with a long columned veranda and shutters.

Peter (walking up the beach in a brown cloak left, leaping from the boat right) has in both short curly dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned weathered face, middle age and sturdy build.

Both show the inside of a deep circular pit of large grey stone blocks with a sandy rubble floor, a parapet rim where the king leans over, and rough rock rising behind the rim in pale daylight; the winch and the propped wooden cover are compatible fittings.

Clothed table under a big oak on grass in both, but the house conflicts: left is a stone-and-plaster cottage with a steep shingle roof, dormers and bay window; right is a thatched half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses.

Left is the yard among pale limestone flat-roofed buildings with terraced olive and cypress slopes behind; right is the dirt road leading to a walled farmstead of the same pale flat-roofed stone buildings among the same olive-dotted hills under the same broken cloud.
Both show the same open wooden boat with a single mast and cream square sail on a grey-green storm-tossed lake under dark cloud, with green-brown cliff-topped hills along the horizon.

Moses (on the rock in profile left; front right with the staff right) is in both an elderly man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard, the same lean build, brown mantle over a pale tunic and a tall staff.

Both show an open single-masted wooden boat shipping water on a dark slate-blue storm sea with dark cliffed hills on the right horizon under black cloud; the right boat has a scroll-carved sternpost the left lacks, a minor detail against the matching sea, shore and boat type.

Both show a sandy shell-and-stone-strewn seabed path through teal-green water with red-ochre desert cliffs on the shore, in daylight on the land; the right sky is heavy storm cloud and the left is clear, but the land, water and path agree as the parting progresses.

Both show an open-topped circular pit of pale dressed stone blocks with a sandy floor and a parapet rim, in daylight with palms and dry earth above; the left's wooden doors at the rim and the right's barred arch with steps differ in detail but the pit itself agrees.

Both show the same open single-masted wooden boat with a cream sail and oars on a grey-green lake under dark storm cloud with green-brown cliffed hills on the horizon; the right adds clearing sky and a village as the calm arrives.

Daniel (standing among the lions left, climbing out at the rim right) is in both an older brown-skinned man with close-cropped grey hair and a short grey beard, slim build, wearing the same fringed blue robe over a white tunic with a satchel.

Left is the dirt road outside pale limestone flat-roofed houses with dry-stone walls and right is the paved yard of a pale limestone house with dry-stone walls; both sit among the same terraced olive hills in clear daylight.
Both show the same dark open wooden boat with a single mast and ragged sail in a black rain-lashed storm on dark green-grey waves, with dark cliffed headlands in the background.

Both show a calm pale-blue lake under a clear sky with a pebbly shore, a fire at the water's edge, cypresses, small stone houses and hazy hills across the water; the right's hut and olive trees sit close by the fire but do not contradict the left.
Both show a wet sandy, stone-strewn seabed corridor between towering dark teal wave walls under the same heavy dark storm cloud with a pale break of light at the far end.

Both show a sandy seabed path through grey-green sea under an overcast daytime sky with tan-and-red sandstone cliffs on the shore; the right is the sandy bank as the waters start to divide and the left the open corridor.

Jesus (arm raised in the boat left; standing by the fire in the blue mantle right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same long slim face, age and build, with the same white tunic and grey-blue mantle.

Both show the same dark wooden boat with a single mast and furled cream sail on a yard, on a dark green-grey heaving sea with dark cliffed headlands behind under storm cloud; the right only adds breaking light.

Both show the same dark open wooden boat with a single mast and rope rigging on a dark grey-green lake ringed by dark cliffed hills under storm cloud; the right is calmer with light breaking through, as the passage requires.

Moses (seen from behind in part-profile with raised crook left; front right with crook right) is in both an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, lean build, brown mantle over a pale tunic and the same crook staff; the back view on the left hides most of the face but no cue conflicts.

Both show an open-topped pit walled in curved courses of grey dressed stone with a sandy floor and lions, in daylight with palms and dry ground above; the left looks wider and has a tall wooden door in the wall while the right shows a well-like rim with a cover and grate, but the stonework, form and surroundings agree.

Jesus (seated by the fire left, standing in the bow right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim face, age and build, with the same cream tunic and dark blue mantle.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor strewn with shells and seaweed between towering grey-green wave walls, leading to the same flat-topped red sandstone mesas on the far shore in daylight; the left sky is a little cloudier.

Both show a wet ochre-sand seabed path with puddles and rocks opening through dark slate-blue water under the same black storm sky, with a sandy bluff at the left edge; the walls of water are simply higher on the right.

Both show a clothed table on grass under a large oak in front of the same kind of pale two-storey clapboard house with a posted veranda, shuttered windows and a panelled front door; the right shows a pediment and steps at the door from a more frontal view.

Table under a big oak on grass in both, but the house conflicts: left is a pale clapboard house with a long posted veranda and shutters; right is a steep-gabled stone and half-timbered cottage with tall stone chimneys and leaded windows.

Both show a calm blue lake under a clear sky with a pebbly sandy shore and a fire at the water's edge, low stone flat-roofed houses, cypresses and olive trees on tawny green slopes with cliffed hills beyond.
